description: System invariants governing deployment, service management, and host synchronization.

invariants.name: Mini-Heartbeat Kit Exclusive Entrypoint
invariants.quoted_invariant: Heartbeat entrypoint (agents): never invoke directly. Use the mini-heartbeat kit only — deploy/mini-heartbeat/bin/ (arm.sh, smoke.sh, launchd) which sources deploy/mini-heartbeat/env/gddp.env via common.sh. Raw runner calls skip GDDP_LOCAL_SUBPROCESS_ARGV / spool and create failed jobs before any executor launches.
invariants.rule: Execute heartbeat passes through deploy/mini-heartbeat/bin/arm.sh, smoke.sh, or launchd to ensure environment variables and attempt spools load properly.
invariants.drift_pattern: Invoking scripts/runtime/heartbeat/runner.py directly in raw shell commands, bypassing attempt spool configuration and generating failed jobs.

invariants.name: Git-Only Host Synchronization
invariants.quoted_invariant: Production host, step zero: on any armed control plane (sab-mini, pi-big, etc.), run git pull --ff-only before anything else. Repo files on production change only via git — never scp, never remote edits. Session is not done until git status --porcelain is empty and HEAD matches origin/main.
invariants.rule: Synchronize host updates exclusively through fast-forward git pull operations, maintaining strict parity with origin/main.
invariants.drift_pattern: Using scp, rsync, or direct remote file edits on production hosts rather than pulling tracked commits.

invariants.name: Single Active Control Plane Host
invariants.quoted_invariant: Only one control plane should run intake + heartbeat. Before arming: run disarm-source.sh on big-ssd (or accept dual-plane risk).
invariants.rule: Keep exactly one machine armed as the active control plane host at any given time (sab-mini).
invariants.drift_pattern: Running heartbeat or intake runners concurrently across multiple machines, creating split-brain queue claims.

invariants.name: Frozen Deployment Surfaces
invariants.quoted_invariant: Components marked as frozen (scripts/intake_server.py, scripts/adapters/jules_*, deploy/rig1-heartbeat/, deploy/deploy.sh, scripts/rollback.py, scripts/export_evaluations.py) receive zero speculative investment and may only be modified when explicitly targeted by a named node.
invariants.rule: Keep legacy deployment assets such as deploy/rig1-heartbeat/ and deploy/deploy.sh dormant and untouched unless explicitly designated in an active node.
invariants.drift_pattern: Refactoring or fixing legacy deploy scripts under deploy/rig1-heartbeat/ without explicit node governance.
